Paste or type a SKILL.md: start with a YAML header between --- lines that gives name (lowercase letters, digits and -) and description (one line: what it does and when to use it), followed by the instructions for Bothy. A saved skill is on and applies from the next request: its description goes into the skill catalog, and the full text is read when needed.

resources.string: Write description on the same line as “description:”: the runtime reads line by line.
description is too short: say what it does and when to use it, so the model knows when to read it.
The body under --- is empty: write how the model should do it.
The first line must be ---: start with a YAML header that gives name and description, and end it with a --- line.
Line %1$s: indented lines belong only under a field with an empty value, such as metadata.
The body has %1$s lines, more than %2$s; consider trimming it or splitting it into several skills.
Under metadata, write “key: value” entries on new, indented lines.
name “%1$s” may use only lowercase letters, digits and -, may not start or end with - or contain --, and has at most %2$s characters.
There is already a skill named “%1$s”. Pick another name (to change a skill you added, tap Edit in the list).
description is missing: one sentence on what it does and when to use it; the model decides from it whether to read the skill.
Line %1$s isn\'t in the form “field: value”.
scenes must be written as [\"scene one\", \"scene two\"].
%1$s: use double quotes or none; the runtime doesn\'t read single quotes.
Over 64 KB: the runtime reads only the first 64 KB.
The YAML header doesn\'t end with a --- line.
